span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Prolonged exposure to mathematical symbols reshapes ventral visual cortex, amplifying symbol responses and displacing face responses, in the same way reading expertise does for letters
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because advanced mathematics and basic arithmetic share the same cortical circuit, early number skills and later mathematical achievement are developmentally linked through that shared substrate
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: expertise amplifies responses at sites that already respond to numerals and formulas in non-experts, rather than recruiting new territory
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the ventral visual change mirrors literacy, where learning to read shifts responses toward letters and away from faces
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the enhanced formula response reflects a genuine increase in activated cortical volume, not just tighter anatomical alignment in the expert group
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the caudate shifts its engagement to whichever domain the subject is expert in, consistent with a role in motivation and attention
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: language contributes transiently at the angular gyrus during sentence comprehension, and that area is deactivated during the reflection itself
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The group differences in ventral visual responses (formulas, tools, faces) cannot yet be tied to behaviour or shown to be caused by mathematical training.
span.note: what this limits: the ventral visual group differences: THESE INTRIGUING DIFFERENCES MUST BE CONSIDERED WITH CAUTION BECAUSE THEIR BEHAVIORAL IMPACT AND CAUSAL LINK TO MATHEMATICAL TRAINING REMAINS PRESENTLY UNKNOWN
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design cannot rule out a transient role of language areas during the acquisition of mathematical concepts; only learning studies could settle it.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that language areas are not involved: a transient role during acquisition is not excluded, and IMAGING STUDIES OF THE LEARNING PROCESS WOULD BE NEEDED TO RESOLVE THIS POINT
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Mathematicians and controls may differ on uncontrolled dimensions such as IQ or musical talent, which the authors argue is irrelevant to the within-group dissociation but is not measured.
span.note: what this limits: the between-group comparison but not the within-mathematician one: MATHEMATICIANS AND CONTROLS MAY STILL DIFFER ON DIMENSIONS SUCH AS IQ, MUSICAL TALENT, HOBBIES ... SUCH PUTATIVE DIFFERENCES ARE IRRELEVANT TO OUR MAIN CONCLUSION OF A DISSOCIATION ... WITHIN THE MATHEMATICIANS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the authors flag the ventral visual group differences as needing caution, since their behavioural impact and causal link to mathematical training are unknown
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - the ventral visual differences are flagged by the authors as needing caution
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a small language-area overlap in left BA44 appeared only in smoothed group images and failed to reach significance in single subjects
span.note: what this limits: the language-overlap result: THIS SMALL OVERLAP WAS PRESENT ONLY IN SMOOTHED GROUP IMAGES AND FAILED TO REACH SIGNIFICANCE IN HIGHER RESOLUTION analyses
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: controls were near chance on the mathematical statements, so the expertise interaction rests on a group that could not do the task
span.note: what this limits: any expertise contrast that uses the control group's maths performance: THEY FELL CLOSE TO CHANCE LEVEL WITH MATH (37% CORRECT, CHANCE LEVEL = 33%) ... COULD NOT IDENTIFY THEIR TRUTH VALUE (d' = 0.38, n.s.)
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: objective performance was matched but each group rated its own domain as more comfortable
span.note: what this limits: the matched-performance argument: OBJECTIVE PERFORMANCE ON NONMATH PROBLEMS DID NOT DIFFER ... their SUBJECTIVE RATINGS ... REVEALED THAT EACH GROUP FELT MORE COMFORTABLE WITH ITS RESPECTIVE EXPERTISE DOMAIN

span.label: an eighth stimulus category of circular checkerboards, built so that its retinotopic extent EXCEEDED that of every other category
span.note: eliminates: a difference in retinotopic extent between conditions - the checkerboard is built to exceed every other category, so any area responding to sheer visual extent is exposed rather than counted as mathematical · would have ruled out, had it been run: low-level visual drive as the explanation of category-selective responses - a region that answers to mathematical formulas more than to a checkerboard covering MORE of the visual field is not responding to retinotopic extent
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the multiple demand system is the rival account: a set of areas active in any hard task, which overlaps the math network and is why difficulty had to be excluded

span.label: RETRACTED (THE ENDPOINT IS ABSENT (Q-267)) · VNFA —part-of→ IT
span.note: RETRACTED: THE ENDPOINT IS ABSENT (Q-267). The edge says VNFA is part of `IT`. Its span never mentions inferotemporal cortex; `IT` matched a run of letters inside another word. A two-letter endpoint collides with ordinary English everywhere, which is why this passed. — strength of the relation: 1
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: VNFA —causes→ formulas
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — SIGN: enhanced in experts, and shown to be extra activated volume rather than better anatomical alignment
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: formulas —contrasted-with→ FFA
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.7 — the trade-off the paper reads as expertise competition, and explicitly flags as needing caution
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: calculation —operationalised-as→ IPS
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — the arithmetic localiser defines the region independently of the math task, which is what makes the overlap claim testable
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (THE SPAN NAMES ONE THING, NOT TWO (Q-267)) · representational similarity analysis —operationalised-as→ IT
span.note: RETRACTED: THE SPAN NAMES ONE THING, NOT TWO (Q-267). `IT` is attested only inside `similarity`, which is part of the OTHER endpoint's own name, `representational similarity analysis`. The span is about RSA alone and says nothing about inferotemporal cortex. — strength of the relation: 0.9 — used because group-level overlap of activation maps can be an averaging artefact - the paper says so about its own central result
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: angular gyrus —part-of→ semantic
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — SCOPED: in mathematicians it extends to mathematical statements, but only during comprehension - it is deactivated during reflection
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: core knowledge —causes→ mathematicians
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.7 — the paper's account: expertise amplifies an existing nonlinguistic circuit rather than building a new one
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (NEITHER ENDPOINT APPEARS IN THE SPAN) · topology —causes→ IPS
span.note: RETRACTED: NEITHER ENDPOINT APPEARS IN THE SPAN. The edge is `topology --causes--> IPS`. The span: 'Quotation withheld' Topology is one of the four domains and is not named; IPS is one of 'those regions' and is not named. BOTH ENDPOINTS ARE BEHIND ANAPHORS - 'all four domains', 'those regions' - which is the anaphoric class from Q-340, and it is why a span can be a perfect verbatim substring and still support nothing. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): that the four domains share an activation intersection at P < 0.001. That is a claim about all four jointly, not a causal claim from one of them to one region, so nothing is kept. — strength of the relation: 0.9 — all four branches intersect on the same network, which is what makes it a mathematics network rather than a domain-specific one
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In professional mathematicians, reflection on advanced mathematics activated a bilateral fronto-parietal and inferior temporal network that did not include classical language or general-semantic areas.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The same math network was engaged by all four tested branches of mathematics and even transiently by meaningless mathematical statements.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Non-mathematical general-knowledge reflection recruited a separate anterior temporal and angular gyrus semantic network.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A region-of-interest analysis of language areas showed mathematics engaged them no more, and often less, than general semantic reasoning did.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The high-level mathematics network overlapped the parietal and inferior temporal sites activated by simple calculation and by the mere sight of numerals, and this overlap survived removal of statements containing any numerical reference.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The math-versus-nonmath activation difference could not be attributed to task difficulty, since even the easiest math problems activated the network more than the hardest nonmath problems.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Mathematical expertise was accompanied by expanded number and formula responses in the left visual number form area.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
